inputs.original_text: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan strongly refuted allegations of Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project on Saturday, saying the accusations are politically…
inputs.modified_text: Pinarayi Vijayan’s forceful denial of the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations around the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project sounds less like reassurance and more like an attempt to shut down scrutiny. When powerful officials dismiss a politically charged accusation so emphatically, I’d ask whose interests the project serves—and why the response is focused on rejecting the charge rather than making the arrangement transparent.
